text:
Maya (PMM): Quick sync — final copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages due EOD Thu. We also need: launch posts, a concise benchmark narrative (for the webinar and a short blog), webinar promo hooks, and the inbound lead routing map. Who can own which pieces?

Liam (Content): I can take hero + 3 bullets for Hosted + Dedicated and draft the launch post hooks. Will aim for two short variants (product-led and enterprise).

Priya (Design): I’ll update the wireframes and CTA placements — need final copy by Wed noon to run visual QA. Can you call out preferred CTA language? (e.g., Start free trial / Request demo)

Jon (Growth): I’ll own webinar outline, registration page copy, and launch cadence (emails + posts). Suggest we do a 30-min webinar: 10m product + 10m benchmarks + 10m customer Q&A. Need top 5 benchmark callouts from the eng team.

Ethan (SEO): I’ll draft title/meta variants. Quick question — priority keyword: "LLM inference platform" as primary, or emphasize "low-cost LLM serving"? That changes header phrasing slightly.

Liam (Content): Raw hero ideas (will iterate):
```
Hosted API — Ship LLM features fast: low-latency generation, streaming, and simple SDKs.
Dedicated — Predictable throughput and reserved GPU capacity with SLA-backed performance.
Private — VPC and on‑prem options for regulated data and full control.
```
CTAs: "Start free trial" (hosted), "Request reserved capacity" (dedicated), "Talk to sales (private)"

Priya (Design): Those read clean. For Dedicated CTA maybe "Get capacity estimate" to reduce friction. I’ll mock placement for both primary + secondary CTAs.

Maya (PMM): For the benchmark narrative — we want 3 short pillars to promote: per-token cost delta with batching + quantization, median tail latency at 95th, and reliability/fallback story (how routing protects uptime). Keep each under one sentence for slides and social cards.

Jon (Growth): Routing + leads: propose 3 lead flows —
- Self-serve (Hosted): register/start trial -> tag: hosted-trial -> route to SDR hosted queue
- Enterprise interest (Dedicated): demo request -> form includes expected qps & budget -> tag: enterprise-dedicated -> route to AE team
- Private & Compliance (Private): contact sales -> include compliance checkbox (HIPAA/GDPR) -> tag: enterprise-private -> route to Solutions Eng + Sales
Add webinar registrants to nurture path A (trial content) and path B (enterprise follow-up) depending on their indicated interest.

Ethan (SEO): For page titles I’ll test two variants: "Redwood — LLM inference platform for developers" and "Low-cost, reliable LLM serving | Redwood". I’ll also add schema for the webinar event.

Liam (Content): Draft launch post hooks (very short):
- "Ship LLM features with consistent performance — Hosted, Dedicated, and Private options. Join our webinar to see benchmarks."
- "Predictable inference economics at scale. Watch our live demo + cost walkthrough."

webinar-bot: Reminder: Webinar draft due Fri 09:00. Calendar invite created for 2025-04-10 10:00 PT.

Maya (PMM): Great — action items:
- Liam: full copy variants for all three pages + two launch post hooks (due Wed 12:00).
- Priya: updated mockups + CTA treatments (due Wed 12:00).
- Jon: webinar outline & registration copy + routing matrix (due Thu EOD).
- Ethan: SEO title/meta + schema (due Thu EOD).
- I’ll corrall benchmark numbers from eng and share a 1-slide summary by Wed EOD.

Anyone want to swap or pick up parts? If not, let’s do a 10-min checkin Wed 10:00 to confirm copy before QA.
